description: This file provides internationalization (i18n) strings for the Select2 plugin in Galician language, version 4.0.6-rc.1.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating how many characters to remove when the input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating how many characters to add when the input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while more results are loading.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching.
